notes.content:
Hey, folks. Steam's build review team ran into a weird rendering bug that made the game unplayable on certain hardware, and I found a couple more bugs. This release attempts to fix them.

[list]
[*] Made MSAA a setting, defaulting to 0 (FXAA is used when MSAA is 0)
[*] Added sheen to water edges
[*] Pointed feedback button to motorstripgames.com
[*] Fixed a bug that autosaved at the main menu
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added new player intros and spawn points
[*] Added wind sound and a kill floor to the starting area
[*] Added tent to cat tower
[*] Worked around initial player rotation bug
[*] Internal: Made SETHOUR accessibile from dungeon onLoad
[/list]

[list]
[*] Made medkits emissive
[*] Added a medkit to the swamp
[*] Made flashlight more effective
[*] Small dialogue tweak
[*] Added an Easter egg that tells you when the game failed to load completely
[*] Disabled analytics
[*] Bugfix
[/list]

* Added music to cyberfortress and Gogol
* Bug fixes
Added medkits
Added some helpful tutorial text

[list]
[*] Added inventory item captions with flavor text
[*] Changed URLs to https
[*] Added a placeholder ending
[/list]

[list]
[*] Changed the title music
[*] Changed the first email
[/list]

* Fixed a small terrain glitch
* Added a neon antenna to draw attention to the first tunnel entrance
* Lowered zombie attack damage and removed 2 enemies from starting area

Thanks to analytics, I have identified and removed some early-game sticking points. Hopefully this will prompt an increase in median playtime.

* Adjusted minimap
* Added a new track to LoRide playlist
* Added a custom analytics solution (sorry if this bothers anyone but I'm trying to catch pacing and difficulty problems)
* Added new option: always_run
* Added an anaglyph eye convergence angle
* Fixed a bug in the settings menu

* Added new settings: max_resolution_scale, anaglyph_3d (put on your red/cyan 3D glasses)
* Added a poster to North Island - Grocery District
* Bugfix
* Redesigned the main menu

* Replaced fog with sky color for more natural distant lighting
* Added a map: cyberfortress
* Fixed seams in terrain generation
* Internal bugfixes

* Stabilized rotation of NPCs
* Added another enemy to South Island
* Improved Gogoler's dialogue
* Fixed a bug affecting vertically centered dialogue choices

* Added interpolated character animation
* Added more detail to South Island interiors
* Added new email text
* Added more detail to Gogol - Advanced Projects Lab

* Added an options menu
* Changed the feedback icon
* Added a warning when starting a new game

* Added a sign to the swamp tower
* Bugfix

* Expanded the main quest
* Fixed a bug that prevented saving time of day
* Added saving and loading

* Added map: Gogol - Advanced Projects Lab
* Added to the main quest
* Bug fixes

* Improved the swamp map
* Added a kill floor to the tunnel to mitigate vehicle glitches

* Improved the swamp map
* Reduced volume of female jump sound
* Added more quest hints

* Added a radar map
* Fixed a rare segfault when you jump from a motorcycle into a door

* Changed crosshairs
* Added a music loop to the swamp
* Added new area to North Island: The Swamp

* Fixed regression that prevented the player from getting shot while driving
* Fixed a bug that prevented impact sounds from playing on terrain
* Fixed line-of-sight tests on terrain

* Terrain improvements in South Island
* Terrain edit bugfix

* Upgraded some terrain to a new system
* Made corpses turn nonphysical
* Bug fixes

* Added new enemy: Hick
* Added more tutorial text
* Added blood and improved particles

* Added zombies
* Added hints on controls

notes.title: Minor addition
notes.content: Added walk-in freezer to grocery store

* Added inventory to pause menu
* Updated email text

* Fixed a skin rendering bug
* Increased the base resolution
* Made vehicles invincible
* Added a little park to Grocery District

* Reduced in-vehicle collision damage
* Prevented the world floor from acting as an agent
* Tweaked shadow fade distance

* Increased draw distance as far as it should go on a 5 TFLOP GPU
* Completely walled off the edges of Grocery District
* Improved southwest building interior
* Added settings INI in userdata folder for controls, language, etc.

* Applied fog to outlines to reduce the "ant trail" effect
* Reduced fog density accordingly
* Increased audio buffer samples from 10 to 16
* Added weapon: Flogger

* Added weapon impact sounds
* Improved Grocery District

* Reduced the starting map's draw distances to avoid a catastrophic number of draw calls
* Eliminated pop-in with stochastic distance fade
* Added an alternate path through the adjacent building

* Added more buildings
* Fixed lighting bugs (and reduced shadow fade distance again)

* Improved the initial loading screen
* Refactored out snake oil "simple" shading since it did nothing for performance

* Per-map shadow configurations improve performance in indoor maps
* Switched rasterization to 3x MSAA if it exists (if it doesn't, 4x is used just as before)
* Fixed a bug that caused the machete to cast an unearthly glow in the water

* Increased shadow buffer resolution (and reduced shadow MSAA to compensate)
* Set the world clock to start in the late afternoon
* Prevented the player from sleeping in the bed
* Replaced an email in the first terminal
* Added a margin around character names in dialogue

[list]
[*] Excluded transparent objects from the bloom pass for a performance boost
[*] Moved the tunnel over the bridge, moved buildings around, increased draw distance, and fixed a visual error for South Island
[*] Fixed some visual issues with the rifle
[*] Temporarily removed the terminal screen vector animation
[*] Increased opacity of window glass
[*] Made underwater jump sound louder
[/list]

[list]
[*] Made the first door puzzle easier
[*] Increased the lighting quality just enough to not completely suck
[*] Enabled drawing a solid color "sea floor" plane to occlude unwanted geometry
[*] Improved North Island - Grocery District
[*] Added a 3D vector animation to the terminal screen
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added remotely operated doors
[*] Optimizations and bug fixes
[/list]

[list]
[*] Named the first catgirl Bubbles
[*] You can kill catgirls with your car
[*] Buttons turn red when you push them. Important feature. Technical reasons.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added the first melee weapon
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug that caused extreme camera rotation on map load
[*] Improved text layout for character dialogue
[*] Improved lighting in Commuter Tunnel
[/list]
